Guangzhou Auge New Materials Technology Co., Ltd. is a foreigntrade enterprise specializing in PVC films, established in June 2019, located at Room 2201, No.30 Huaxia Road, Tianhe District, Guangzhou.
Our export business covers more than 14 countries and regions across Asia, Europe, Africa, the Americas and Oceania. The company owns 3 registered trademarks and 10 utility model patents, and has been certified as a HighTech Enterprise.
Auge New Materials is one of China’s leading premium brands for ecofriendly laminated decorative surfacing products for residential and wholebuilding applications. For its laminated surfacing products, the company adopts Germanimported calendering production equipment and raw materials, with optimized and upgraded production systems for manufacturing. Manufactured in strict compliance with internationallyrecognized environmental standards, all products are waterbased and ecofriendly, featuring nanoantibacterial, mildewproof, highflameretardant, antioxidation, weatherresistant, stainresistant and scratchresistant properties.
Focusing on every production link starting from raw materials, Auge New Materials produces film substrates inhouse and implements fullprocess integrated production, enabling direct quality control from rawmaterial input to finishedproduct output. Meanwhile, we are committed to developing highquality laminated materials that are ecofriendly, durable, userfriendly and aesthetically refined. Up to now, we offer a wide range of products with extensive application scope, embodying the pursuit of human aesthetics through lamination. Laminated surfacing materials have been widely integrated into daily life, applied in architecture, furniture, doors & windows, flooring, refrigerators, air conditioners, speakers, as well as automobiles, ships and highspeed rails.
